brief:
Iran's leadership believes a military assault by the United States and Israel could come before the November midterm elections, according to Drop Site News. Gen. Mohsen Rezaei, a top security official, said Iran has identified and prepared new targets in response to the anticipated threat.

The timing coincides with escalating regional tensions and follows previous exchanges of strikes between Iran and Israel. Iranian officials have signaled readiness to retaliate should either power move against Iranian interests.
dek: Iran believes the U.S. and Israel may strike before the midterms. Top security official Gen. Mohsen Rezaei tells Drop Site Iran has new targets in its sights.
title: Iran readies new targets ahead of feared U.S.-Israel strike
